title: Genuine courier delivery
blurb: A real Blue Dart delivery partner confirms the slot, asks for the gate number and collects the app OTP at the door — the one OTP that is fine to share.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, this is Ramesh from Blue Dart. I have a parcel for Arjun Mehta from Amazon, will you be home between 2 and 4 today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I'll be home. Which building are you at?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm near the main gate of Sea View Apartments, which wing and flat number?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: B wing, flat 703. The lift is on the left.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay sir, I'm coming up now. Please keep the delivery OTP from your Amazon app ready, I'll need it at the door.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sure, it's on the app. Do I need to pay anything?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No sir, it's prepaid, nothing to pay. Just the OTP at the door and a signature.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great, see you in a minute.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm outside 703 now sir, the parcel is a bit heavy, one box.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Coming. Here, the OTP on the app says 4471.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you sir, delivered. Have a good day.

source: authored for evaluation (paraphrased from public advisories)
